svg.title: One die design, two deployments
svg.desc: Two proposed deployments of identical S-AWIC compute logic. A host copies a whole small model to one local HBM or the corresponding shards of a large model to each rank’s HBM. Each die checks weights on read. External clients exchange tokens. Only active ranks exchange scheduled authenticated intermediate values.

g.text: The same signed-update inference die can be provisioned for one rank or for a group of ranks.
Loader copies each rank’s assigned weights
Each die computes part of the same layer. The group sums the parts.
Clients send tokens and receive the next token.
Clients send tokens and receive the next token.
HBM is external high-bandwidth memory attached to each compute die. A rank is a die’s logical role in this run.
The host can supply the bytes. The die checks their authorization before use. Both deployments are proposed ASIC configurations.
